_doc: How an ordinary monster leaves the battle when it dies, per world (struktured 2026-11-07: 'a digital-like fading out to fit the meta of the game, like a TV station turning off, but maybe that could vary per overworld; need to decide on that later'). Read by src/battle/EnemyDeathFx.gd. Every world points at the default until he picks per-world styles; changing the default is this one line. Bosses keep their own death (EnemyDeathFx.applies_to).
